name: Silent Mobius: Alice Ridell
original_name: サイレントメビウス - アリス・リデル
source:
Based on the manga and anime Silent Möbius, this game tells a new story set in its universe. It follows Alice Ridell, a mysterious woman with amnesia who becomes drawn into a case at the Tokyo Police Corporation's AMP division. Original Silent Möbius character Saiko Yuki and AMP officer Katsumi Lqueur step in to help her. Players take the roles of Saiko and Alice, switching between them over the course of the story. Gameplay is a mix between Japanese-style adventure games and an interactive movie, with limited interactivity based around selecting from options in certain scenes.

[From [URL=https://www.mobygames.com/game/172401/silent-mobius-alice-ridell-digital-motion-picture/]MobyGames[/URL]]
translation:
该游戏改编自漫画和动画《沉默的莫比乌斯》，讲述了一个以宇宙为背景的新故事。该剧讲述了患有失忆症的神秘女性爱丽丝·里德尔 (Alice Ridell) 被卷入东京警察公司AMP部门的一起案件中的故事。原版《无声莫比乌斯》角色由纪斋子和AMP军官克己·鲁盖尔介入帮助她。玩家扮演西子和爱丽丝的角色，在故事的进程中在他们之间切换。游戏玩法是日式冒险游戏和互动电影的混合体，基于从某些场景中的选项进行选择的交互性有限。

[来自 [URL=https://www.mobygames.com/game/172401/silent-mobius-alice-ridell-digital-motion-picture/]MobyGames[/URL]]
